title: 彭博能源主编：中国能源安全布局，战略储备与电动车降低依赖
speaker: Steven Stachinsky

segments.en: So, before we let you go, I do want to ask you about China because crude imports fell 20% in April. That's the lowest level since 2022. About half of Chinese supply as you know comes from the Middle East, talk to us a little bit about what China has done to insulate itself from this exact scenario, but it's not a perfect system and how long can they last given the hit to their energy supply.
segments.zh: 最后问一下中国：4月原油进口下降20%，为2022年以来最低。中国一半供应来自中东，他们如何应对？能撑多久？

segments.en: I think China for much of the last decade has cared so much about energy security and they've they've diversified in so many different ways. I could go, you know, we could talk for an hour, but what they've done, but let's just look at oil, for example, they've actually been increasing their domestic oil production.
segments.zh: 过去十年中国高度重视能源安全，多元化布局。以石油为例，他们一直在增加国内产量。

segments.en: They're also very strategic with their reserves. A lot of last year, you know, we were talking about run rates being sort of low at Chinese refiners and yet their imports for crude were so high because they were filling up their strategic reserves when oil and Brent was around $60, $70, the Chinese were buying. So they actually have a lot of strategic reserves there as well.
segments.zh: 他们战略性地补充储备：去年油价在60-70美元时大量进口，炼厂开工率低但进口高，就是在填充战略储备。

segments.en: They've limited the amount of fuel that they're they're also exported, you know, it's been going on and off in the early days of the war that they asked the refiners to kind of cut back on exports there. And at the same time, when you look at their how they consume oil, that's also shifting, you know, it's this is more of a long term story, but you know, the EV boom and the electric truck boom everything in China means that they're going to be depending less and less on that fuel in the future.
segments.zh: 他们还限制燃料出口，要求炼厂削减出口。长期看，电动车和电动卡车普及将降低石油依赖。
